scope: C01 train-only preprocessing fitter over the reviewed FORCE 2020 train split (repair1); software-only; product C01 stays not_run

tool_versions.packages: stdlib only (argparse, datetime, hashlib, importlib.util, json, math, pathlib, re, sys, zipfile)

repair.PF01: prior revision parsed all numeric tokens including label/confidence/coordinate columns; fixed to parse depth index 0 and the four selected channel indices only; regression test instruments _strict_number call counts (exactly 15 calls for a 3-row fixture: depth + 4 channels) and proves unselected opaque sentinels are never converted; selected/depth opaque tokens still fail with member+line; module docstring corrected to describe FORCE curve-profile preprocessing (GR, RHOB, NPHI, RDEP), explicitly distinct from the online sim_em_v2 summary contract
repair.PF02: prior revision accepted the same parent root in train and validation when explicit fixture expectations mirrored counts; now enforces unique row_id and (source_domain, well_id), member sha256 and UWI identity against the inventory, derived root equality with the FORCE parent pattern, declared split counts, and root purity via read-only data/grouping.py:validate_split_assignments before fitting; regressions cover shared parent across splits, sidetrack grouping within one split, wrong well_id with matching bytes, unknown/cyclic parents, cross-domain derivatives and duplicate identity

comparison_to_snapshot.result: bitwise identical channels, train block, fitting member list and row totals; same algorithm and order

readback.script: readback2.py (captured copy in the capture directory; embedded in the log)
readback.note: independent hash/consistency readback including identity, UWI, member-sha, root-purity recomputation and helper-hash checks

earlier_capture_set.note: cli and compare stdout are byte-identical between the two capture runs; the earlier readback validated the then-current preprocessing.json sha256 d431481598d701970ec970e1e9a46ff0aa9f2cdf7a382dee0a576ca972309d5f, superseded by the same-statistics regeneration now validated by readback2

implementation_job.observability: route observable from the controller result file; model/effort stated by the assignment brief only

failures_and_fixes: First development dry fit failed with NameError (_parse_null referenced but not defined); fixed by adding the local parser before any formal evidence run.

First unit-test iteration: 9 of 25 failed because archive-rewrite tests needed a refreshed splits source_archive_sha256 and the import allowlist needed '__future__'; fixed, then the formal suite passed 25/25.
Main review PF01/PF02 rejected the first-wave result; this repair1 revision fixes both and adds guarded regressions (33 tests).

Loading read-only data/grouping.py via importlib initially failed for frozen dataclasses ('NoneType' has no '__dict__'); fixed by registering the module in sys.modules during exec_module (try/finally pop).
One test intentionally writes a duplicate ZIP entry, so CPython emits an expected UserWarning into that run's stderr; raw bytes preserved.

An earlier repair capture used a readback script whose 'grouping root purity enforced' check was vacuous ('or True'); replaced in the final capture by readback2 recomputation of identity and root purity; final capture is the cited evidence.
limits: Software-only preprocessing fit; no model training, no causal replay windows, no verify_data entrypoint and no online scene.
Not C01 acceptance, not calibration and not evidence of real sensor capability; all product and hardware cards remain not_run.
No validation/test statistics were computed; held-out members were never decompressed.

The preprocessing.json document is regenerated per run and differs between runs only in its generated_utc field; fitted statistics are reproducible and were proven unchanged against the frozen snapshot.
Provider/model/effort beyond the route string are not runtime-observable in this child run.
